Impressed with the tech of the cook.
Jul 2026 • Family
Initially choose Hello You because you see the name on the Michelin list in Hanoi. But the reason to go back is completely different, because of the unique culinary personality that chef founder Vincent Cao Minh created. As a French-Vietnamese hybrid, he skillfully integrated French style into the Vietnamese cuisine space without blurring Vietnamese identity. Orange leaf burning cream is a typical example, pure Vietnamese ingredients, the recipe is French, the result is a rich American dessert. Not only is it good to eat, but it is also open with eyes.

Creative food in French style.
Jul 2026 • Solo
What impresses me most in Chau You is how founder chef Vincent Cao Minh puts French culinary techniques into traditional Vietnamese dishes without losing their original taste. The slow-cooking swine bark in the French slow-cooking style but the spice is entirely Vietnamese, resulting in a moderate luxury and close proximity. The ice cream burn too. This French dish but using the ingredient is the orange leaves of Vietnam create a new taste that attracts. The villa space also evokes that cultural intersection. The pictures of France hang in the dining rooms.
